pose-host <id-or-name> Deprecated alias for --compose-client\n --compose-computer <id-or-name> Sandbox im
age to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-model <id...> Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the

urce, connection, settings.reasoningEffort) as JSON (or @file, or -): one cell for its model, at its effort. Alongside --compose-m
odel. Repeat it to add several selections for one model (e.g. at low and at high) — each distinct selection is its own cell.\n --
with-client-default Also launch an inherit cell that uses each client's pinned model, alongside --compose-mode
l\n --save-targets Attach the composed environments to the suite (append, capped at 10). Default is ep
hemeral.\n --compose-server <id-or-name...> Server(s) to pin on the composed stack. Snapshots them into a server group,
so the run keeps testing these servers even if the host's own server list changes later. Mutually exclusive with --compose-server-
group.\n --compose-server-group <id> Standalone server group to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-host-servers
No longer supported: eval runs take their servers from a server group. Use --compose-server or --compose-serve
r-group.\n --compose-skill <id...> Project-shared skill IDs to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-secret <i
d...> Project SECRET IDs the composed stack grants to its runs. Without one a composed stack carries no credentia
